messages:
maria.fp: CloudInsight sent the updated quote + SOW for cost monitoring/ingest. attaching link: https://ci.example.com/redwood-sow
jonathan-s: can you paste headline numbers here? blocked on that link from my machine.
devex-ryan: also need to know how they meter embeddings vs eval events vs analytics API calls.
cloudinsight-sales: hi team — quick breakdown: PAYG: $0.20 / 1k embeddings ingested, $0.003 / 1k eval events, analytics API calls included up to 500k/mo then $0.05 / 1k. 12mo commit = 12% discount, 24mo = 22% + 2mo free credit.
maria.fp: sample invoice for 50M embeddings + 10M eval events please. is analytics counted separately?
cloudinsight-sales: sample invoice (rounded):
Line: embeddings.ingest | Qty: 50,000 (1k units) | Rate: $0.20 | Amount: $10,000
Line: events.eval | Qty: 10,000 (1k) | Rate: $0.003 | Amount: $30
Analytics: 0 (within 500k included)
Total: $10,030
jonathan-s: looks right. what about minimum commit, overages, and credit banking?
cloudinsight-sales: commits = annualized monthly minimum. Overages billed at PAYG. Banking: 12mo/24mo allow up to 3 months residual credit.
procurement-bot: Reminder: spend > $50k/yr needs Procurement + Legal signoff. attach quote + SOW to ticket.
maria.fp: legal will ask about termination, SLA, data retention. any early termination fees?
cloudinsight-sales: pilot/no-penalty period ok. standard early termination = prorated refund of prepaid months minus implementation costs (capped). SLA: 99.9% control plane; dedicated plan has ingestion throughput SLOs. Credits: 5% of monthly fee per 30m downtime window past threshold.
devex-ryan: can we get an engineering appendix — P90/P95 ingest latency at 1M events/day baseline, retention options (raw logs)?
cloudinsight-sales: appendix in SOW v2 excerpt: P95 ingest latency ~120ms on standard; ~60ms on dedicated. retention: raw logs default 90d, optional 365d at extra cost.
jonathan-s: invoicing cadence and payment terms?
cloudinsight-sales: monthly in arrears Net30 by default. prepaid monthly amortization offered on committed plans.
maria.fp: suggestion: run PAYG pilot for 2 months using $5k trial credit, then evaluate 12mo commit. confirm no penalty for pilot.
cloudinsight-sales: confirmed — $5k trial credit, no early termination penalty during pilot. sending PO-ready quote EOD and can meet tomorrow 10am PST to discuss.
procurement-bot: Next step: add quote + SOW to procurement ticket PR-2026-348 and flag Legal if commitment projected > $50k/yr.
jonathan-s: +1 to pilot. I'll pull usage samples for TCO and DM them.
maria.fp: I'll export last 30d embedding counts from billing and share in #finance-private, then loop in Legal. :thumbsup:
cloudinsight-sales: thanks everyone — updated quote sent.
